steps: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the ability of a computer or machine to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence.
These tasks include learning, reasoning, problem-solving and understanding language.
items.finalAnswer: AI enables computers and machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence.

steps: The idea of intelligent machines developed over many years as computers became more powerful.
In 1950, Alan Turing discussed whether machines could think and proposed a test for machine intelligence.
The term Artificial Intelligence was introduced at the Dartmouth Conference in 1956.
Early AI systems followed rules to solve problems; later, machine learning and deep learning enabled computers to learn from data.
Today, AI is used in areas such as healthcare, education, transport and communication.
items.finalAnswer: AI developed from early ideas about machine intelligence into modern systems that can learn from data.

steps: AI can help doctors analyse medical images, such as X-rays, to identify diseases.
AI can assist in diagnosing illnesses and recommending suitable treatments.
items.finalAnswer: AI is used to analyse medical images and to assist with diagnosis and treatment.

steps: AI techniques enable computers to learn patterns from data instead of relying only on explicitly programmed instructions.
Machine-learning algorithms use these patterns to make predictions or decisions.
Techniques such as neural networks can learn complex patterns and improve model performance when trained with suitable data.
items.finalAnswer: AI techniques help machine-learning models learn patterns from data and make better predictions or decisions.

steps: The Internet of Things (IoT) is a network of physical objects connected to the internet.
These objects contain sensors, software or other technologies that allow them to collect and exchange data.
items.finalAnswer: IoT is a network of physical objects connected to the internet that collect and exchange data.

steps: IoT connects devices and systems so they can communicate and share data over the internet.
Sensors can collect information from the surroundings and send it to other devices or systems.
This allows devices to be monitored and controlled remotely and can automate everyday tasks.
items.finalAnswer: IoT enables connected devices and systems to share data, communicate and be controlled remotely.

steps: AI systems may produce biased or unfair results if they are trained on biased data.
AI and IoT devices can threaten privacy by collecting personal or sensitive information.
Connected devices and systems may be vulnerable to hacking, data theft and other security problems.
Automation may replace some jobs, and people may become overly dependent on technology.
items.finalAnswer: Risks of AI and IoT include bias, privacy loss, security threats, job displacement and overdependence on technology.

steps: AI and IoT can make daily life easier through automation and faster access to information and services.
They are used in homes, healthcare, education, transport and communication.
They can improve efficiency and help people make decisions using data.
However, they may also create concerns about privacy, security, employment and dependence on technology.
items.finalAnswer: AI and IoT make many daily activities more efficient and convenient, but they also bring social and security concerns.
